title: Dämonenkopf und Wildstyle
concept: Blauer Affendämon mit irrem Grinsen links, daneben ein Chrom-Wildstyle-Schriftzug auf gelbem Strahlenhintergrund. Der Schriftzug liest sich klar als RAgents, das kleine g sitzt sauber im Wortbild.
prompt: Photograph of a large graffiti mural on a rough concrete wall. On the left, a wild cartoon demon character head: blue ape-like demon with a huge insane grin, crooked yellow teeth, narrow malicious slit eyes, big sticking-out ears, thick heavy black outlines, painted with spray cans. On the right, a full wildstyle graffiti piece spelling exactly the word "RAgents" - capital R, capital A, then lowercase g e n t s - interlocking silver chrome letters with black outlines, arrows and 3D depth. The word must read clearly and be spelled exactly R-A-g-e-n-t-s, no other letters, no extra words. Bright yellow background with blue rays and red smoke swirls, drips and splatter. Street art photography, daylight, gritty urban, no corporate look.

title: Roboter malt den Blockbuster

The piece reads exactly the word "RAgents" - capital R, capital A, then lowercase g e n t s - fat black 3D block letters with a light blue and white chrome cloud behind them, splatters and drips. The lettering must be perfectly legible and spelled exactly R-A-g-e-n-t-s, no other words, no misspelling. Thick black outlines, cartoon character style, urban daylight street photography, gritty underground vibe.
